Title: Hellbent Dirty Shirley
Body HTML:
A cherry-forward sparkling vodka cocktail with a sharp citrus edge. Sweet on the way in, wicked on the way out.

  • 200 mL single-serve can
  • 17% ABV
  • Tasting notes: Sweet cherry flavor, bright citrus, and a smooth finish.
